headline.purpose: Campaign page and section titles; left-aligned, fixed rem.

shadows.name: flat-desk
shadows.purpose: Default resting state for lists, forms, and most cards.

shadows.name: hairline-ring
shadows.purpose: Card separation without drop shadow (ring-1 ring-foreground/10).

shadows.name: priority-lift
shadows.purpose: Soft ambient lift for overview/insight panels only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Mandate Red CTA — the one clear next action on a region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: #c51414; color: #ffffff; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #c51414 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, #c51414 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: #f5f5f4; color: #292524; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #f5f5f4 80%, #1c1917); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, #c51414 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Bordered quiet action on the desk.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #e7e5e4; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; color: #1c1917; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #f4f4f5; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, #c51414 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Campaign Input
components.description: Compact field with visible stone border; campaign radius-md.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #d6d3d1; border-radius: 6px; background: #ffffff; color: #1c1917; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgb(28 25 23 / 50%); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #c51414; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, #c51414 30%, transparent); } .ds-input:disabled { background: #f5f5f4; color: rgb(28 25 23 / 55%); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Pill status chip — engaged / pending / negative via semantic tokens.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge-engaged { background: #dcfce7; color: #166534; } .ds-badge-pending { background: #fef3c7; color: #92400e; }

components.name: Desk Card
components.description: Flat card with hairline ring — default container on the field desk.
components.html:
Núcleo Centro

Estimativa confirmada · 3 lideranças
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 12px; background: #ffffff; color: #1c1917; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgb(28 25 23 / 10%); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.375; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #6b7280; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Campaign Mobile Nav
components.description: Mobile top bar in Mandate Red with white wordmark.
components.css: .ds-nav-mobile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 16px; background: #c51414; color: #ffffff; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-title { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-sub { font-size: 0.75rem; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 80%); }

narrative.overview:
Teqo’s visual system is a sober ops surface for people organizing under pressure. Design defaults to `/campanha`: stone-white surfaces, Inter, and brand red as a signal (primary actions, selection, status urgency) — never as spectacle or brochure chrome. Staff screens can be information-dense; leadership paths stay phone-first with larger touch targets and obvious next actions.

Public themes (`editorial`, `petition`, and the home brand-red body) share the same token contract and primary red, but they are surface variants. When inventing new UI, start from the campaign desk unless the task is explicitly a public/marketing page.

The system rejects generic SaaS dashboards (purple gradients, hero-metric templates, identical card grids, AI-startup chrome) and traditional Brazilian campaign kitsch (clipart flags, shouty all-caps, brochure clutter). Sovereignty and clarity beat decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Product register: familiar shadcn affordances, earned consistency over surprise
Restrained color strategy: neutrals dominate; primary red ≤ ~10% of any screen
Hybrid elevation: flat lists/forms; light lift only for priority or overlay surfaces
Confident and compact controls — denser desktop, phone-first leadership paths
Semantic status colors (support / estimate / cadence) carry meaning, not fashion

rules.name: The Signal Red Rule
rules.body: Mandate Red is for primary action, focus, and urgency. It must not wash backgrounds, decorate cards, or paint inactive chrome.

rules.name: The Theme Contract Rule
rules.body: New surfaces reuse the shadcn token names (`primary`, `muted`, `field-*`, etc.). Do not introduce one-off hex outside a `data-theme` block.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Inter everywhere in product UI. No decorative display faces in buttons, labels, or data.

rules.name: The Fixed Scale Rule
rules.body: Prefer rem/Tailwind steps over fluid clamp() headings inside the campaign shell.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Lift appears for priority or overlay — never as default card decoration across a grid.

dos: Do treat `/campanha` as the design default: stone desk, Inter, Signal Red for the next action.
Do keep primary red rare — one clear CTA per region beats a sea of red buttons.
Do use semantic Badge tokens for support/estimate/cadence state.
Do keep leadership paths phone-first: obvious actions, larger taps, plain language.
Do meet WCAG 2.2 AA (contrast, keyboard, focus rings, prefers-reduced-motion).
Do reuse shadcn primitives (Button, Input, Badge, Card, dialogs/sheets) for consistency.
donts: Don't ship generic SaaS dashboards — purple gradients, hero-metric templates, identical card grids, AI-startup chrome.
Don't ship traditional Brazilian campaign kitsch — clipart flags, shouty all-caps, brochure clutter.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left/border-right > 1px) as accent decoration.
Don't use gradient text or glassmorphism as default chrome.
Don't put tiny uppercase tracked eyebrows above every section.
Don't use Petition Gold or home body gradients inside the campaign desk.
Don't invent display fonts for UI labels, buttons, or data.
Don't lift every card; flat is the desk's resting state.
